summary: WorksheetAssignedInstructor manages group and individual instructor assignment for placement worksheets in the HSPnet system. It handles allocation, assignment tallying, scheduling, calendar icon display, instructor display logic, and supervisor/preceptor integration. Business logic includes workflow for tallying assignments, block management, aggregation of stats (available, assigned, remaining), instructor formatting (up to three per entry), calendar navigation, site/supervisor logic, and rules for display and indicators (overallocated, unavailable, site instructor requested).
purpose: To support the allocation and management of instructor assignments within placement worksheets, including grouping logic, block assignments, calendar integration, and display of relevant metrics, as well as navigation and status indicators for various actors.

workflows.name: Assignment Tally
steps: Initialize stats for available, assigned, remaining counts.
Iterate over groups and/or entries.
For each group or entry: retrieve accepted count.
For blocks: retrieve Block1Assigned, Block2Assigned if GroupHasBlock2.
Calculate remaining for each block (Accepted - Assigned).
If remaining is zero, mark entry as NotAvailable.
Display formatted values and icons based on status.
If overallocated, display overalloc indicator.
Aggregate totals for stats.
Show adjust hours option if partial allocation exists.

workflows.name: Instructor Display Logic
steps: For entry with InstructorID: format name and display popup.
If InstructorHasCourses: display eOrientation status icon.
If InstructorID2 or InstructorID3 present: append formatted names and status.
If groupFlag and SupervisorID present: display supervisor name/icon.
If UseSiteInstructor and ProgramUseSiteInstructor and SupervisorID is zero: display site instructor requested icon.
If HasMultiplePreceptors: link to preceptors popup.

workflows.name: Calendar Navigation
steps: If PRD_ID and DestinationID present: ShowCalendarGridIcon = true.
If groupFlag: navigate to CalendarGrid.aspx using hashed URL.
If not groupFlag: navigate to CalendarGridNonGrp.aspx using hashed URL.
If AmendmentExists: show 'changes exist' icon and tooltip.
Else: show default calendar grid icon and tooltip.

workflows.name: Filtering and Aggregation
steps: Apply filters on groupFlag, cohortID, termID, courseID, siteID, campus, section, instructor, date, service, agency, city, governingOrg, department, block, etc.
Aggregate and format filter lists for instructors, dates, cities, governing orgs, sites, services.

workflows.name: Preceptor and Supervisor Integration
steps: If not groupFlag and PreceptorID exists: format short preceptor name.
If StudentGenderRequired: append destination icon for gender requirement.

business_rules: If groupFlag is true, group logic applies including GroupHasBlock2.
Accepted count represents maximum possible assignments.
Assigned counts tallied per block; remaining calculated as Accepted - Assigned.
If remaining = 0 for all blocks, entry is NotAvailable.
Overallocated if remaining < 0; display error indicator.
Calendar icons and navigation determined by PRD_ID, DestinationID, groupFlag, AmendmentExists.
Instructor display includes up to three instructors, each with status indicators.
Site instructor display rules: icon shown if UseSiteInstructor and ProgramUseSiteInstructor and SupervisorID is zero.
validations: UUID and int conversions for keys and IDs.
Null and empty checks for fields (e.g., RequestCode, DestinationDetails, Comments, PositionNumber).
Block, group, and site instructor logic checked for display indicators.
calculations: Totals aggregated for Available, Assigned, Remaining, both raw and filtered.
RotationIndicatorFormatted based on presence and assignment sort order.
Formatted columns (dates, names, icons, etc.) based on logic and field values.
conditions: If groupFlag is true or false, alternate logics apply.
If Block1Assigned and Block2Assigned are present, apply block-based workflow.
If NotAvailable, entry is flagged and filtered column totals adjusted.
system_behavior: Aggregates worksheet assignments for instructors, groups, and blocks.
Formats display values and icons conditionally.
Supports navigation to calendar and preceptor popups.
Processes assignment using filters and workflow steps.
Handles grouping, block, and supervisor logic for display.
exceptions: If PreceptorID is present (for non-groupFlag), name is short-formatted.
If block assignment counts are negative, entry flagged as overallocated.
If UUID conversion fails, fallback logic applies.
If details popup fails to open, no icon shown.
